title: Bounded per-file inspection after combined status timeout
failure_signature: A combined status, existence, and diff-stat probe exceeded its command window after returning only partial decisive output.
candidate_workaround: Split existence, status, and content inspection into bounded per-file calls and promote only complete outputs.
recurrence_guard: Do not append an unbounded diff-stat walk to the first file-existence witness on a large packet.
rollback: Retain the timeout, ignore incomplete aggregate output except its explicit file-existence rows, and rerun bounded checks.
scope_boundary: Operational inspection only; it does not validate artifact semantics, privacy, or final integrity.
